architecture.shape: many stateless executors -> one canonical authority
architecture.executors_have: no ledger; they cannot take over an uncertain execution
architecture.router: consumes a prepared snapshot and remains pure

idempotency_rules.evidence: receipts/free-tier replay after pod replacement; receipts/intelligence restart-replay.json
conflicting fingerprint returned HTTP 400 with no second physical execution
provider-saturation pod-proof.json: prior uncertain execution refused after pod replacement

admission_control.measured_test: 64 concurrent requests from two stateless OS processes against the production authority HTTP protocol
admission_control.fixture: counted local HTTP fixture — NOT 64 paid provider calls and NOT two Kubernetes replicas

configured_caps.provenance: POLICY INPUTS from an operator handoff, not reproduced measurements
configured_caps.disclaimer: The saturation report states plainly that the handoff's referenced ~330-probe report was not independently recovered or reproduced. Only the 32-admission test above is measured here.

openrouter.note: later raised to 1 as conservative single-call admission after validated free-route evidence

vercel.note: later set to 8 from imported health evidence; a free-credit call still reported a nonzero cost and stayed excluded by free_only

provider_headroom.detail: Per-provider headroom claims (e.g. Cerebras/DeepSeek/Jev large headroom, a Groq wall at measured concurrency, a lower NVIDIA wall, local serialization) are NOT reproduced in the imported receipts. The local dual-request serialization is the only per-provider concurrency behaviour measured here (two simultaneous local requests -> one real call, one refusal before HTTP).
provider_headroom.local_serialization: verified: 2 simultaneous requests produced 1 real Ollama call and 1 refusal before HTTP; final inflight 0

configured_caps.eligibility_semantics: eligibility checks credentials, cap and durable health; unprobed providers are labelled eligible_unprobed, not healthy; 401/403 requires explicit operator reset; 429 creates a cooldown and permits fallback

lifecycle.supervision: enabled user systemd unit z0intelligence.service with lingering enabled
lifecycle.readiness_publication: lifecycle hooks publish readiness to the existing Kind EndpointSlice

concurrency_probe.note: backpressure is explicit 503; there is no unbounded queue

no_autoscaling.reason: the lane is a Service/EndpointSlice targeting one host process with no Deployment/StatefulSet scale target; KEDA and the Kubernetes metrics API are absent. Scaling a proxy would not increase model capacity.

kind_connectivity_repair.problem: pod-to-host TCP access to 172.19.0.1:11501 timed out; EndpointSlice ready=false
kind_connectivity_repair.finding: the listener was already bound to 127.0.0.1 and 172.19.0.1; UFW was active; the Kind network's first IPAM entry is IPv6, so selecting entry zero alone would give the wrong address family
kind_connectivity_repair.fix: one persistent, scoped UFW ingress rule on the Kind bridge interface, with a rollback command recorded
kind_connectivity_repair.verified_after: Kind node /healthz passed; pod /readyz passed directly and via Service DNS; a real router request returned PARENT_ONLY with no external model call; EndpointSlice ready=true
kind_connectivity_repair.not_established: the host service remains session-managed by systemd user unit only; this repair does not by itself establish reboot availability

operational_limits: The remote executor is at-most-once replica-safe only when every replica uses the same authority. There is no HA authority and no completion guarantee after a crash.
Uncertain claims and their permits are retained; there is no lease expiry or automatic retry. Uncertain work must be reconciled before restoring capacity.
At one point the deployed pod was Running but deliberately NotReady (HTTP 503) because its only configured credential was an OpenRouter secret whose cap was 0.
Cerebras was account-blocked after a real HTTP 403 despite being the configured default, while the host service remained ready and had proven DeepSeek/Jev/local execution.
